lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: All-Knowing Boss!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Do you know what a Swiss army knife is?
Aaaah... Yes, of course!
Is it the popular toy that's in vogue these days?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Your reaction tells me that you actually don't have a clue.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: You might just hurt yourself if you treat it as a toy!
I know, it's a knife isn't it?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I knew you'd be familiar with it!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: But, it's no ordinary knife.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Besides the knife blade, it's packed with all sorts of other features.
Like?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: It comes with a screwdriver,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: a pair of scissors, a bottle opener, a toothpick,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: pliers, and even a hammer!
Sounds quite convenient.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Also, I heard that if you go to a specialty shop,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: they'll hook you up with any extra features you're after.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: So, I wanted to ask:

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: what features would you like to add?
A stun gun for emergencies.
An alarm that I can use if I'm in trouble.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Oooh, that'd be really useful

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: for someone as important as you!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: That's a good idea,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: especially 'cause you're weak and can't defend yourself.
What about you?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I've been thinking about it,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: but I can't seem to decide.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I just wanna cram in everything imaginable!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Every little detail, every possibility! I want it all in there!
Why don't you make one yourself then?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Then, I can add all the features I want!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I didn't even think of that!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I bet trying out all those different features would totally level up my skills, too!
Exactly!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Wow, my motivation is through the roof!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Thanks, Boss!
